1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and __at least one flange__ member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; __at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, wherein the composite fabric layer is applied as a discrete patch separate from the laminated composite tape members__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas __and is applied as a discrete patch separate from the laminated composite tape members__.

3. (Original) [Claim 3 text not provided in application materials]

4. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas __and the adhesive is applied as a structural adhesive sheet that is distinct from any adhesive resin contained within the laminated composite tape members__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other __and the offset is created by intentional placement of discrete fabric patches rather than wrinkles or deformation in the laminated composite tape__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric __applied as a discrete patch__ covering the radius areas of the channels and the base __and separate from the laminated composite tape forming the channels and base__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes __three or more discrete composite patches__ respectively on each of the channels and the base __and each patch is applied separately from the laminated composite tape members__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler __and the structural adhesive sheet is applied as a distinct layer separate from any adhesive resin contained within the laminated composite tape members__.

14. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges __and comprises a structural adhesive sheet that is distinct from adhesive resins within the laminated composite tape__.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __formed from laminated composite tape and the base is formed from laminated composite tape, and the composite fabric patches are applied as discrete layers separate from the laminated composite tape members__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape __with a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and a base, each including radius areas between the web and the flanges and between the cap and base and the web__; __a cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone__; __a layer of composite fabric applied as discrete patches in the radius areas and radius filler zones, separate from the laminated composite tape members__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and __a layer of structural adhesive sheet surrounding and joining the filler to the composite fabric patches in the radius filler zone, wherein the structural adhesive sheet is distinct from any adhesive resin contained within the laminated composite tape members__.
